en: Color postcard showing a formal botanical garden with trimmed hedges, flowerbeds, a small round fountain, tall conifer and deciduous trees, paths, and small garden buildings. Distant hills are visible. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp with a horse, a CLUJ postmark dated 1973, and a printed caption identifying the location as the botanical garden in Jibou.
